action_summary: Reverted the ensemble to the best-known v111 configuration: re-enabled run_weight_x3d and run_weight_eeg_raw, disabled the v113 double_head member whose reimplemented Modeleeg/Modelspec is mismatched with its checkpoints (score 0.45). Restored Net1d to the v111 layout (view(bs,16,1000,10) -> reshape (bs,160,1000), AdaptiveAvgPool2d, no neck layer) and load its weights with strict=False (printing missing/unexpected keys) so the run cannot fail on neck keys. Added clipping and row renormalisation of the averaged predictions so the submission is a valid probability distribution for the KL-divergence metric.
